crossRefs.note: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
Let the priests, the ministers of Yahweh, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people…
Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, where is Yahweh your God? Then my enemy will see me…

translations.web: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
translations.bsb: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
translations.kjv: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?
translations.asv: As with a sword in my bones, mine adversaries reproach me, While they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
